purpose: After each test fold is scored, write every trial’s predicted curve and per-trial R² so canvas analyses do not need to reload checkpoints.

files.holdout_trials.csv: One row per test-fold trial: identity, trial_r2, onset/peak, slices.
files.holdout_curves.npz: Ragged y/pred (float32), concatenated with n_bins. Full predicted curve (not interpolation-masked). Align rows with holdout_trials.csv.

questions.question: What is the per-trial R² distribution on each test fold (median, mean, % of trials > 0.4, left tail)?
What does the predicted kinematic curve look like versus ground truth on each held-out trial?
How does onset from the predicted curve compare to the onset-head readout and a constant mode predictor, on the now vs next clock?
Does the model miss peak time, peak amplitude, or return-to-zero shape?
Where do individual trials fail — atlas cluster, length, delayed onset, contrast, mouse/session?
How do interp / LOSO / LOMO test folds differ trial by trial?
